title: LNSym ARMv8 AES-256-GCM: Complete Encryption Kernel Symbolic Proof
description: Full-repository upstream cryptography snapshot from AWS Automated Reasoning's leanprover/LNSym (commit 49f8a1d9, Lean v4.35.0, Apache-2.0). Closes the sole open `sorry` in `Proofs/AES-GCM/AESGCMEncKernelSym.lean` (`AESGCMEncKernelProgram.aes_gcm_enc_kernel_program_run_xx`), proving error-freedom across 139 ARMv8 instructions of AWS-LC's AES-256-GCM encryption kernel against LNSym's 80 prebuilt sorry-free ISA, memory-separation, and symbolic-simulation dependency modules.

tasks.title: Prove error-freedom of 139-step AWS-LC ARMv8 AES-256-GCM encryption kernel
tasks.description: Closes the sole remaining `sorry` at `Proofs/AES-GCM/AESGCMEncKernelSym.lean:52` (`AESGCMEncKernelProgram.aes_gcm_enc_kernel_program_run_xx`): discharge step 139 (the AES-256 round-count branch at pc `0x7cf79c` / `0x7cf838`) so `read_err sf = .None` holds with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `leanprover/LNSym@49f8a1d9`.
